section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the Body and Appearance Self-Conscious Emotions Scale (BASES), a measurement instrument used to assess four body-related emotions: shame, guilt, hubristic pride, and authentic pride. Each subscale contains 4 items rated on a 5-point scale, and the section reports internal consistency values (Cronbach's alpha) for each subscale, ranging from .81 to .91. This is a methods/instruments section with no participant demographics, study design, or correlation data.
